title: The Unofficial Detention
author: Petra Okonkwo
blurb: Sebastian Yarrow, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
